messages:
sara: Thanks for the questions in today's all-hands about remote/hybrid and travel. I'll summarize what we can confirm now and flag open items. Drop anything else here and we'll add to the canonical FAQ. :memo:

leah: Quick Q: If my team wants a recurring "office day" every 2nd Friday, can managers enforce that or does it need org-level approval?

sara: Managers can set team norms (including recurring days). If your schedule impacts cross-team meetings or shared spaces, coordinate with your GM so we can avoid collisions.

dan: Any updates on the commuter/parking stipend pilots? We had a pilot last year but I heard it's ending?

sara: Clarification: the commuter subsidy pilot in SF/Denver ends this quarter. We're evaluating an expansion based on participation and budget; any changes will get a 30-day notice. For people with recurring parking needs, People Ops can review case-by-case.

priya: For offsites, what are the rules around bringing partners/family? Is there a travel subsidy?
tom: For company-sponsored global offsites, we run a limited family/partner travel stipend pilot. It's not guaranteed and will be listed on the offsite page. Managers can request exceptions for headcount-critical contributors.

leah: Visa support? I had a teammate ask if Redwood issues invitation letters for consulates.
sara: Yes 12 for company events we provide invitation/attendance letters and will reimburse visa fees if submitted via the travel request form beforehand. Use the "visa_support" field on the form.

ops-bot: Heads-up: to ensure vendor availability and visas, submit travel requests at least 14 days before travel. For international travel, 30 days recommended.

dan: What about health/medical coverage on international trips? Any supplemental travel insurance?

priya: We provide a basic travel insurance policy for official international offsites. If you need extended coverage (family, adventure sports, long stays), let People Ops know and we'll arrange supplemental options at company rate; personal upgrades are allowed at your cost.

leah: Hoteling: can teams reserve a block of desks for a week-long offsite?
sara: Yes 12 People Ops supports temporary desk blocks for offsites or concentrated weeks. Submit requests 10 business days ahead so facilities can set up access. Permanent reserved desks can be provisioned quarterly on request.

tom: Finance/process note: when you submit the travel form, pick the appropriate project code (OFFSITE-2026) so expenses map automatically. If your vendor needs a PO, contact finance@redwood and cc me.

dan: Childcare support? Anything official?
sara: For 2026 we are piloting a modest childcare stipend for selected offsites. The criteria will be posted; managers can nominate team members. We'll evaluate after the pilot.

priya: Who signs off on exceptions (dates, extra nights, additional guests)?
sara: Operational exceptions are manager + People Ops. Budget or policy exceptions escalate to Finance and the GM for approval.

leah: One small ask from engineering leads: a recommended vendor list for group flights/hotels to make bookings smoother.
tom: We have preferred travel partners listed in the travel form dropdown. If a vendor isn't there, choose "other" and tag me; I'll route it to procurement to negotiate.

ops-bot: Reminder: expense submission target is 12 business days after return for standard reimbursements. Use code EXP-OFFSITE-2026 for faster processing.

priya: ADA/accommodation note: if anyone needs accommodations (quiet rooms, accessible parking, schedule flexibility), contact People Ops privately and we will handle it confidentially.

sara: Action items I will own: 1) Update the remote/hybrid FAQ and pin to the People Ops channel by next Monday. 2) Publish offsite booking checklist and vendor list. 3) Add childcare stipend pilot details to the travel page.

leah: Can you @channel the checklist when it's live so leads can review?
sara: Yep 12 I'll post here and ping eng-leads. If you need a private follow-up, DM me or Priya.

dan: Thanks everyone 12 this clears up a lot.

priya: Thanks 12 appreciate the quick answers.

sara: Thanks all. Keep the Qs coming and we'll fold them into the living FAQ.
